response.justification: Bogdan has extensive experience in software development, leadership, and developer tooling, with a strong technical background in multiple languages and systems. However, his experience in mobile platforms is limited, and his people management experience is not clearly highlighted beyond team contributions. His recent roles focus more on full-stack engineering rather than dedicated developer tools or build systems.
strengths: 9+ years of software development experience with a broad technical stack (TypeScript, Node.js, Dlang, Java, etc.)
Proven technical leadership in developer tooling, testing frameworks (e.g., Fluent-Asserts), and CI/CD processes
Experience leading teams and organizing workshops, demonstrating mentorship and collaboration skills
concerns: Limited explicit experience in mobile-platform ecosystems or build systems (key focus areas for the role)
People management experience is implied but not explicitly detailed as a formal leadership role
Recent roles emphasize full-stack engineering over specialized developer tooling or productivity infrastructure
